entry.name: Braixen-H
entry.flavor: It ignites the twig from its tail and waves the twig around to signal its allies. To indicate danger, it draws circles in the air with the twig's flame.
entry.flavorEs: Al extraer la rama que tiene en la cola, esta prende debido a la fricción. Usa esa rama candente para enviar señales a sus compañeros.

abilities.textEn: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Fire attacks.
abilities.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Fuego cuando le quedan pocos PS.
abilities.detail: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando a este Pokémon le queda 1/3 o menos de sus PS, sus movimientos de tipo Fuego infligen 1.5× de daño normal.
abilities.detailZh: 当该宝可梦剩余HP为1/3或以下时，其火属性招式造成1.5×的常规伤害。
abilities.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon tem 1/3 ou menos do seu HP restante, seus movimentos do tipo Fogo infligem 1.5× o dano normal.

abilities.textEn: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack.
abilities.textEs: Roba el objeto del Pokémon al que alcance con un movimiento.
abilities.detail: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight.
abilities.detailEs: Roba el objeto equipado del objetivo cuando el portador usa un movimiento que causa daño.
abilities.detailZh: 持有该特性的宝可梦使用攻击招式时，会偷走目标携带的道具。
abilities.detailPt: Rouba o item segurado do alvo quando o portador usa um movimento de dano.
